chunks: And Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan narrated from Ibn Abi Najran, from Muhammad ibn al-Fadl, from Hammad ibn Abd al-Karim, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: "When the Qaim (peace be upon him) rises, the people will say, 'How can this be, when his bones have decayed for a long time?'

key_terms.الْقَائِم: The Riser, referring to the Mahdi

ai.seo_question: What will people say about the longevity of the Imam when he rises?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights the psychological skepticism of the masses regarding the Mahdi’s longevity, reflecting the common human tendency to equate physical decay with death. It underscores the miraculous nature of the Imam’s life (*Umr al-Mutawalla*) and serves as a precursor to the divine confirmation of his continued existence despite the passage of centuries.
